# Weaverbird Garments Manufacturers Ltd

> Kenyan uniform and apparel manufacturer founded in 1996, making school, corporate, security, sports and hospitality wear at its Thika factory and delivering nationwide.

Weaverbird handles the whole process in-house: weaving, cutting, embroidery, screen printing, tailoring, quality control and delivery. Orders can be placed through the online quote request or at any of the branches across Kenya.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of products, capabilities, industries served and how to order.
- [Products](/products): Uniform categories including school, corporate, security, sports, hospitality and industrial wear.
- [Services](/services): Embroidery, screen printing, weaving, cutting and stitching, sampling, tailoring, bulk manufacturing and delivery.
- [Branches](/branches): Shop and factory locations across Kenya with a searchable map.
- [About](/about): Company story since 1996, mission, values and leadership.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, social channels and factory location in Thika.
- [Request a Quote](/quote): Form for bulk uniform quotes with garment details and branding options.
- [Uniform Care Guide](/blog/uniform-care): How to remove oil, ink, blood, grass and sweat stains from uniforms.
